title: Knowledge check: Legacy Tooling and Ecosystem

questions.prompt: Which approach best matches “Legacy Tooling and Ecosystem”?
options: Skip reproduction steps and deployment notes.
Inventory dependencies and existing behavior, add regression checks, change incrementally, and keep a rollback/documentation path.
Upgrade every dependency at once without recording current behavior.
Assume Vue 2 automatically receives Vue 3 APIs.
questions.answer_key: Inventory dependencies and existing behavior, add regression checks, change incrementally, and keep a rollback/documentation path.
questions.explanation: This answer addresses Legacy Tooling and Ecosystem directly. Verify the behavior in a small Vue 3 example and check the runtime requirements in the linked official reference.

questions.prompt: A learner example for “Legacy Tooling and Ecosystem” behaves unexpectedly. What should be checked first?
